name: Restaurant Menu
short_description: Turn WooCommerce into an app-like food menu with delivery, takeaway, dine-in, add-ons, time slots, reservations, and kitchen display.
description:
Restaurant Menu for WooCommerce gives food businesses a single-page ordering experience built on top of your existing WooCommerce products. Customers browse your menu by category, pick extras and sizes, choose how they want to receive their order, and check out, all without leaving the menu page. In the back office, your kitchen gets a dedicated view of today’s orders, sorted by due time.

It works with your current products, categories, payment methods, and shipping. There is nothing to import and no separate catalog to maintain.

Who it is for

  • Restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and ghost kitchens taking orders online.
  • Takeaway and food-court counters that want pickup time slots.
  • Venues that accept dine-in orders and table reservations through the same store.
  • Businesses with multiple locations that need customers to choose a branch.

A menu built for ordering

  • One-page menu added with the [yeemenu] shortcode. Choose a right-sidebar, three-column, or full-width layout, and grid or list product views.
  • Category tabs and Top Selling: dishes are grouped by WooCommerce category. Show best sellers automatically or pick them yourself.
  • Live search and filtering without page reloads.
  • Quick View: every dish opens in a popup where customers pick options and add to cart. Variable products and products with add-ons are handled in the same window.
  • Product labels such as “Hot” or “New” on menu cards.
  • Responsive design with configurable products per row for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Brand colour setting so the menu matches your site.

Add-ons, sizes, and extras

  • Add option groups to any product: single choice (radio) or multiple choice (checkbox), with a price for each option and optional size variants per option.
  • Mark groups as required. The rules are enforced in the browser and again on the server when the item is added to the cart.
  • Chosen options and their prices appear on the cart, checkout, order emails and the admin order screen.
  • Also shown on the standard single product page, so the Shop page and the menu stay consistent.

Delivery, takeaway, and dine-in

  • Enable any combination of Delivery, Takeaway (pickup) and Dine-In.
  • Store branches with name, address, phone, and email. Customers choose the branch for pickup or dine-in orders.
  • Guest count for dine-in orders.
  • Shipping is hidden automatically for takeaway and dine-in orders.
  • Service details are saved on the order and shown to the customer and in the admin.

Opening hours and time slots

  • Set opening hours per weekday, with several open periods per day and closed days.
  • Time slots are generated from your hours and a slot duration you choose (15 to 240 minutes).
  • Customers pick a slot for delivery, pickup, or dine-in. Slots already in the past are hidden.
  • Pre-orders: let customers order outside opening hours for a slot up to seven days ahead, or restrict orders to today only.
  • An optional opening-hours card shows today’s status (open now, pre-order, or closed) on the menu.
  • Works on sites in any language.

Cart drawer, tips, and notes

  • An order summary sidebar with service selection, time slot, order notes, and a tip field.
  • Remembers customer choices between visits for logged-in customers.
  • Compatible with both the classic checkout and the WooCommerce block checkout.

Table reservations

  • Accept bookings with the [yeemenu_reservation] shortcode: date, time slot, party size, and contact details.
  • Set the maximum party size and how many days in advance customers may book.
  • Auto-confirm bookings, or review them first. Reservations are stored as WooCommerce orders with their own status.
  • Email notifications to the admin for new reservations and to the customer when a reservation is confirmed.

Kitchen and admin tools

  • Chef View: a one-click filter on the WooCommerce Orders screen that shows today’s active orders sorted by their time slot, with a live countdown.
  • Served and Skip buttons mark an order completed or cancelled straight from the list.
  • Extra columns and filters for service type, branch, guest count, and time slot (today, tomorrow, or a custom date).
  • New-order alerts in wp-admin: an in-page popup and an audible chime, with an optional custom sound file.
  • Time-slot reminder emails sent to customers before their slot.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

name: SMTRY Amend
short_description: Give customers a simple way to request post-purchase order changes while you stay in control of approvals, updates, and automation.
description:
Give customers more flexibility. Keep control of every order.

Customers sometimes need to change an order after checkout. Perhaps they’ve entered the wrong delivery address, forgotten an important instruction, or need to request a cancellation.

Without a structured process, these requests can lead to additional support emails, delayed responses, and manual administration.

SMTRY Amend for WooCommerce makes post-purchase order changes easier to manage.

Give customers a dedicated self-service experience where they can request changes to existing orders, while your team remains in control of what gets approved, declined, or applied.

A better way to manage post-purchase changes

SMTRY Amend helps WooCommerce stores handle customer requests through a controlled and transparent workflow.

Rather than allowing customers to freely modify completed purchases, the extension separates customer requests from actual order changes.

Customers can submit their requests, and your team can review them before taking action.

For carefully selected low-risk changes, optional automation can reduce manual work while respecting your store’s configured safeguards.

What can customers request?

Depending on your store’s configuration, customers can request:

  • Shipping address corrections: Fix delivery information before fulfillment.
  • Delivery instruction updates: Add or correct important delivery details.
  • Order cancellations: Request cancellation before an order is completed.
  • Item changes: Request modifications to products within an order.
  • Quantity changes: Request adjustments to ordered quantities.

You decide which request types are available and when customers can submit them.

Stay in control of every request

Not every order change should happen automatically.

Changing quantities, modifying paid orders, or cancelling purchases can have consequences for inventory, payments, and fulfillment.

SMTRY Amend is designed around controlled decision-making.

Merchant controls include:

  • Configurable request windows.
  • Eligible order status restrictions.
  • Individual request-type permissions.
  • Manual approval and decline workflows.
  • Request withdrawal handling.
  • Optional low-risk automation.
  • Dry-run controls and manual fallback.
  • Order change history and audit records.

These controls help prevent customers from making unrestricted changes to orders that may already be processing or fulfilled.

Reduce repetitive customer support work

Simple order corrections should not always require lengthy email conversations.

With SMTRY Amend, customers have a clear way to submit requests, and staff can review the relevant order information alongside each request.

This creates a more organised workflow for both customers and store administrators.

Instead of managing changes across disconnected emails, merchants can keep requests, decisions, and order context together.

Optional automation without sacrificing control

Some changes are straightforward. Others require human review.

SMTRY Amend supports optional automation for eligible, low-risk requests.

Merchants can configure which actions are permitted and use dry-run controls to assess automation behaviour.

When a request cannot be safely processed automatically, the workflow can fall back to manual review.

Financially sensitive changes, including paid cancellations and refunds, remain subject to merchant control.

Built with order safety in mind

SMTRY Amend includes safeguards designed to protect the integrity of your WooCommerce orders.

These include checks around:

  • Paid order cancellations.
  • Stock-sensitive modifications.
  • Changes to previously updated order data.
  • Orders that have already been fulfilled.
  • Requests that fall outside configured eligibility rules.

The goal is simple: provide useful customer flexibility without introducing unnecessary operational risk.

Keep a clear history of decisions

Understanding what happened to an order is important.

SMTRY Amend keeps an audit history of requests and decisions, helping merchants understand which changes were requested, reviewed, accepted, or declined.

This provides greater visibility when resolving customer enquiries or reviewing order activity.

Privacy-focused by design

Your customers’ order information belongs in your store.

SMTRY Amend stores request information within your existing WordPress and WooCommerce database.

The extension does not transmit order information to SMTRY or VariationDesk Ltd.

It also does not include advertising, behavioural tracking, or its own external analytics service.

Emails generated by the extension use your existing WordPress email configuration.

Designed for WooCommerce merchants

SMTRY Amend is suitable for online stores that want to:

  • Provide better post-purchase customer service.
  • Reduce repetitive order amendment enquiries.
  • Give customers a structured way to request changes.
  • Maintain control over cancellations and order modifications.
  • Introduce automation without removing important safeguards.
  • Keep a clear record of customer requests and merchant decisions.

Whether you’re managing a small online shop or a growing ecommerce business, SMTRY Amend provides a focused way to handle order amendment requests.

Better customer flexibility. Better merchant control.

Customers get a clearer experience after checkout.

Your team gets a more organised workflow for managing changes.

And your store retains control over which order modifications are permitted.

SMTRY Amend for WooCommerce — make post-purchase order changes easier to manage.

name: My Account Dashboard Builder
short_description: Branded My Account dashboard: drag-and-drop menu, Design Studio, Buy again, returns, personal offers and self-service tools.
description:
My Account dashboard builder

Branded My Account dashboard: drag-and-drop menu, Design Studio, Buy again, returns, personal offers and self-service tools.

Highlights

  • A drag-and-drop account menu with your own pages, groups, and links
  • A Design Studio with a live preview and ready-made looks
  • Personal coupon offers and banners for the right customers
  • Self-service returns, cancellations, and an address book
  • View My Account exactly as any customer sees it

Make My Account work as hard as your shop pages

Every logged-in customer lands on My Account, yet in most stores it is a plain list of links. It is where customers check an order, change an address and decide whether to buy again, and where they get stuck and email you instead.

My Account Dashboard Builder turns it into a dashboard that matches your brand: a menu customers find their way around, account numbers and order tracking at a glance, offers that bring them back, and tools that answer their own questions. No theme templates to edit and no code to write.

  • Drag-and-Drop Menu: Reorder, rename, hide, and nest account pages on a canvas drawn the way customers see it.
  • Your Own Account Pages: Add endpoints, links, WordPress pages, and collapsible groups, with Classic or Block editor content.
  • The Right Items for the Right People: Show an item by role, dates, products bought, orders placed, amount spent, or time since the last order.
  • Menus for Customer Groups : Give wholesale buyers or members a menu of their own, while item settings stay shared.
  • Design Studio: Change colours, layout, density, and type beside a live preview at desktop, tablet, and phone widths.
  • Arrange the Dashboard: Put account numbers, the profile meter, shortcut tiles, order tracking, and Buy again in the order you want.
  • View as a Customer: See any customer’s menu, badges, and offers, plus what is hidden from them and why. Nothing changes for them.
  • Personal Offers: Banners that hand each customer a one-use coupon of their own, with Copy and Use it now.
  • Returns and Cancellations: Customers cancel unshipped orders and request returns with a photo; you answer from one screen.
  • Buy Again: Past purchases one click from the cart, plus recently viewed products and order tracking.
  • Customer Fields: Ask for a VAT number, a birthday, or “How did you hear about us?” at registration and in account details.
  • Insights: See which account pages customers open, which banners they click, and the sales personal offers bring.

Features:

  • Drag-and-drop menu canvas, with keyboard moves
  • Custom endpoints, links, WordPress pages and groups
  • Font Awesome icons or your own images
  • Badges and live status badges (“one to pay”, “one open”)
  • Visibility rules by role, date, purchases, and order history
  • Separate menus for customer groups
  • Design Studio with six ready-made looks, plus your own
  • Account numbers, profile meter and shortcut tiles on the dashboard
  • Banners with personal coupon offers
  • Returns, order cancellation, address book and privacy page
  • Buy again, recently viewed and order tracking
  • Custom registration and account fields
  • Smart tags such as {first_name} and {total_spent}
  • Insights, import/export, WPML, and Polylang ready

Build the menu on a canvas

The Menu Items screen draws your account menu exactly as customers see it. Drag an item to move it or drop it into a group, flip its switch to hide it, and click it to edit its label, icon, and badge. The canvas follows as you type.

Add your own Account pages

Click Add to menu, pick a type and type a label. Fill a page with the Classic or Block editor, shown before, after, or instead of WooCommerce’s own content. Smart tags greet each customer by name.

  • Endpoint — a page of its own under My Account, e.g. /my-account/help-center/
  • Group — a collapsible heading that holds other items
  • Link — any URL, in the same or a new tab
  • Page — one of your WordPress pages

Show each item to the right customers

Every item and banner has the same visibility rules: user roles, a date range, products bought, at least or at most a number of orders, an amount spent, or a last order more than N days ago. A VIP page for big spenders or a “we miss you” offer takes a minute to set up.

A Menu for Every Customer Group

Wholesale buyers or members can create their own menu. It starts as a copy of the main menu; take items out, add others and reorder it. Everyone else keeps the main menu.

Design it beside a live preview

The Design Studio shows the real account page at desktop, tablet, and phone widths while you change colours, typeface, density, the menu style and the profile card. Start from a look:

  • Classic Sidebar — a left menu with a subtle active bar
  • Modern Cards — raised cards with icon chips
  • Rounded Pills — soft pill items with a coloured active state
  • Tabbed Top — a tab bar above the content
  • Minimal — flat and borderless
  • Theme Native — your theme’s own styling

Arrange the Dashboard

Drag the greeting, account numbers, profile meter, shortcut tiles, order tracking and Buy again into any order, or hide them. The preview follows at once, and nothing goes live until you save.

See My Account as any customer

Pick a customer in View as and the preview shows their menu, badges, offers, and dashboard. A bar lists everything hidden from them, and why. It only looks: nothing is changed, sent, or counted for them.

Banners and personal offers

Put banners at the top or bottom of any account page, with an icon, text, a link and an order or cart count. Switch on a personal offer and each customer who sees the banner gets a one-use coupon for their own email, valid for the days you choose.

Self-Service returns and cancellations

Customers cancel an order that has not shipped, within the hours you allow, and request a return on a completed order with a reason and a photo. You answer each request on the Returns tab, and the customer is emailed.

Buy Again, Recently Viewed and Order Tracking

Past purchases sit one click from the cart, recently viewed products wait on their own page, and recent orders show their progress on the dashboard.

Ask customers the questions you need

Add a VAT number, a company, a birthday or a dropdown to the registration form and account details. Answers show on the admin order screen and work as smart tags.

Know what gets used

Insights counts account page views, banner clicks, and the sales personal offers bring, over seven, 30, or 90 days. Only daily totals are kept.

Works on Phones

On small screens, the menu folds into an Account menu button.
